reasons.title: 21 Reasons Why You're My Favourite Person
reasons.subtitle: Tap every card — I wrote one for each year of you.
items: I genuinely don't think anyone can replace the kind of person you are. Your personality, your charm, your craziness — everything about you is special to me.
I love the way you handle every problem so effortlessly. Somehow, you make even the most complicated situations feel so simple and smooth.
Even the most normal and boring moments become memorable when you're around.
You have this natural way of making people notice you. Madam, your main-character energy is genuinely unmatched!
Good food, dressing up, makeup, shopping and enjoying every little moment — you know how to live life to the fullest.
Your voice notes are better than any playlist.
Whatever comes your way, you somehow find a way to figure things out. I genuinely admire your strength and attitude.
Your expressions, your reactions, your drama and your random behaviour — there's never a dull moment with you.

I love how you always tell me what's right and what's wrong, correct me whenever I need it, and never hesitate to stand by me. Chahe mujhe koi advice chahiye ho, koi problem ho ya bas samajh nahi aa raha ho ki kya karna hai — I know I can count on you. You always want the best for me, and that means so much. ❤️
You don't even have to do anything special. Just having you around makes my day a little brighter.
I never feel the need to pretend to be perfect around you. I can just be myself.
Love ur eyes, ur smile, and everything that is ur's.
You give the warmest hugs in this entire world.

The way you carry yourself, express yourself and do whatever you want without doubting yourself — I genuinely admire that. And I love how you're ALWAYS ready for everything! College mein kisi bhi club ka event ho, koi competition ho, ya koi extracurricular activity — madam is always up for it! You never miss a chance to try something new. Keep that confidence and never stop being this enthusiastic!
Your heart is the softest place I know.
There are so many little things about you that I admire, and I hope you never stop being the confident, independent and wonderful person you are.
You're my 2 AM emergency contact and my 2 PM random thought.
I love how you find reasons to enjoy, celebrate and make the most of every moment. Life feels a little more colourful with someone like you around.
Your pictures, your outfits, your random updates, your achievements, your happiness — I genuinely love seeing you happy and living your best life. Never stop being your favourite person!

Out of all the people I could have met in college in 2023, I'm so glad our paths crossed. You're not just my best friend; you're someone I respect, admire, trust and love so much. And if I had to choose my favourite person all over again, I'd choose you every single time.
Because in a world of billions, you feel like home with u only rashu.

letter.title: A Letter For You
letter.hint: sealed with love (and a little glitter)
letter.body:
Sometimes, the most beautiful friendships begin with the most ordinary moments. Back in 2023, during our first year of college, we started talking, and little did I know that you'd become such an important part of my life. ❤️

From random conversations to endless laughter, silly memories and all those moments that only we understand, we've come a long way. And honestly, I'm so glad that out of all the people I could have met, I met YOU!

I hope you know how much you mean to me. You are someone I can share my happiest moments, my stupidest thoughts and even my most confusing situations with. Life feels a little better when you have someone like that.

Now that you're turning 21, I wish you nothing but happiness, beautiful experiences, exciting opportunities and everything your heart secretly wishes for. May you achieve all your dreams, meet the best people and create memories that you'll cherish forever.

And remember, you don't have to figure everything out right now. Enjoy your journey, make mistakes, take chances and live every moment to the fullest. You have so many beautiful chapters waiting for you and i am always here for u my bbg!

Here's to 21 years of YOU, and to all the amazing years ahead. Never stop being the main character of your own story. 👑

I'm so lucky to have you in my life. Love you loads, meri pagalu!

So make a wish tonight, my love. And when you blow out your candles, know that I'm wishing right along with you.
letter.closing: Happy 21st, my favourite human. Here's to you — always.

finale.heading: Born to Be the Main Character 👑
finale.message: 21 years of being YOU — and honestly, the world is lucky to have a girl like you! From your little adventures to your big dreams, from your crazy moments to all the happiness you create, you make life look like one beautiful celebration. Toh madam, today the spotlight is ALL yours. No ordinary wishes for an extraordinary girl. Keep dreaming big, making memories, collecting achievements and living life on your own terms. Because this isn't just another birthday, it's the beginning of another fabulous chapter of YOUR story. And trust me, the best is yet to come love! 💗
finale.hugMessage: Wrap your arms around yourself — that's me, holding you across the miles. I'm so proud of you, and I love you endlessly. Happy 21st, Princess. ❤️
